# Proto-Dionae
While a Protogen-Dionae is a rare sight to behold, it's not impossible. Transhumanism exists even among plant-like races, although the practice is typically shunned.
## Racial Features - Their blood is made of sap, easily recognizable by its orange color. - They [color=#ffa500]cannot wear shoes[/color], instead [color=#1e90ff]they are able to root themselves to the floor which works like a form of magboots[/color]. - While rooted, they absorb any puddle they step on into their bloodstream and receive a [color=#ffa500]10% movement speed decrease[/color]. - They are [color=#1e90ff]not slowed down by kudzu[/color]. - They get hungry and thirsty [color=#1e90ff]45% slower[/color]. - [color=#ffa500]PlantBGone causes brute damage[/color] when in contact with a Diona, be it in their bloodstream or on their bark. - [color=#ffa500]Weed killer causes poison damage[/color] when in contact with a Diona, be it in their bloodstream or on their bark. - [color=#1e90ff]Robust harvest heals brute and poison damage[/color] when in their bloodstream, using too much at once can have side effects. - They take [color=#1e90ff]20% less Blunt damage and 10% less Slash damage[/color]. - They take [color=#ffa500]25% more Heat damage[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1e90ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - They [color=#1e90ff]can regrow lost limbs[/color]. - Due to having their brain inside their torso, they [color=#1e90ff]can survive losing their head[/color] but will be unable to speak or see without it. - Thanks to their plant biology, Diona suffocate [color=#1e90ff]50% slower[/color] and can breathe CO2. - Their fists deal [color=red]5[/color] blunt damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## The risks of Robust harvest
Being exposed to too much Robust Harvest will cause a Diona to grow out of control, turning into an immobile tree and dropping all of their equipment. Cutting down the tree will "restore" the Diona to their mobile state.
## Diona Nymphs
[color=red]WARNING![/color] Splitting into nymphs as a Proto-Dionae will [color=red]turn you back into a normal Diona![/color] Choose carefully, is it really worth it to lose your cybernetics?
After death, a Diona can voluntarily destroy their own body, releasing their "internal organs" as three Nymphs, with the player taking control of the Brain Nymph. It can talk but has neither hands nor means to carry anything, and can't do much by itself.
After 5 minutes, a Nymph can reform into a whole Diona. This will be a completely new body and it is not unusual for Diona that undergo this process to change names. There will be little to no evidence beyond their word about who they were before.
## Sylvan and Trinary The Diona language, known as Sylvan, is a language composed of gentle brushes and chirps. It is often described as graceful or peaceful and is able to be spoken by most species, albeit with some difficulties. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names A Diona's lifespan is very different than that of most other species, as they are functionally immortal thanks to their ability to split and reform. Nymphs are often considered the infant stage of Diona, even if the brain nymph may possess centuries of knowledge and experience, with the fully formed Diona being considered the adult stage. They choose their own names upon reforming, following a pattern of nouns, adjectives, verbs and adverbs. The most common pattern is "The (Noun) of (Adjective)".
